purpose: Preselected harder held-out IR-only prediction challenge; no prediction outcome was consulted.
selection_rule: First test-row index with 9 heavy atoms, at least 2 hetero atoms, at least 2 rings, at least 1 double/triple bond, and Murcko scaffold absent from train/validation. Structural complexity is a selection heuristic, not measured model difficulty.
limitations: Same supplied simulated dataset and supported chemical domain; not an independently acquired experimental IR spectrum.
Exact identity, exact model-input array, and exact RDKit Murcko scaffold were checked; chemical motifs or close analogues can still occur in training.
One challenge is illustrative and does not replace aggregate held-out test evaluation.
The actual trained prediction runs on Unity; no result is claimed before that run.

post_prediction_novelty_audit.correction: The original exact Murcko-SMILES check did not normalize tautomers. The earlier unseen-ring-framework description was too strong; an alternate tautomer of the same heavy-atom framework occurs in training.
